subject: Geopolitics
title: The East Mediterranean Gas Rush
description: A micro-lesson that makes The East Mediterranean Gas Rush usable.

hook.text: Huge gas fields found off Israel, Cyprus, and Egypt turned the East Mediterranean into an energy hotspot.

buildup.text: Israel's Leviathan field and Egypt's Zohr field hold trillions of cubic feet. Enough to supply Europe for decades.

discovery.text: New gas finds shifted regional alliances.

twist.text: Turkey disputes maritime boundaries. It sent warships to block Cypriot drilling.

climax.text: Energy discoveries can unite or divide. In the East Mediterranean, they did both within the same decade.

punchline.text: Find gas under the sea and watch borders heat up.

quiz.question: What tension did East Mediterranean gas discoveries create?
options: Egypt and Israel went to war over the fields
Turkey disputed maritime boundaries and blocked drilling
All regional powers agreed to share revenues equally
